title: Wanted!
start: Begin by speaking to Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador Park.

items.t: Either 10,000 coins, or an enchanted gem, molten glass, and a law rune
20 un-noted rune essence or pure essence (can be obtained during quest)

recommended.t: Spiny helmet or slayer helmet (there is a chance you need to go to Lumbridge swamp dungeon)
Activated Falador, Varrock, Taverley, and Canifis lodestone
An Archaeology teleport to get to the Black Knight's Base by teleporting to collector Isaura

rewards.t: 20 noted pure/rune essence and the other items (from chasing Solus)

steps.t: Talk to Sir Tiffy in Falador park. [Chat: 1 Do you have any jobs for me yet? › Accept]
Talk to him again. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Wanted! quest]
Talk to Sir Amik Varze, floor 3 of White Knights' Castle in the west wing. Decline his offer. [Chat: 2 Speak about the Wanted! quest. › 3 No, not right now...]
Return to Sir Tiffy. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Wanted! quest]
Talk to Amik Varze again. [Chat: 2 Speak about the Wanted! quest. › 3 Sure, I'll help you!]
Return to Sir Tiffy for a commorb. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Wanted! quest]

sub.t: If you are buying a commorb [Chat: 1 Buy one › 1 YES › 1 YES]
If you are making one [Chat: 2 Have One Made › 1 YES]

steps.t: Right-click contact with the commorb to view your assignment details. [Chat: 1 Current Assignment]
Head to the Taverley Dungeon and go to the south-westernmost area of the Black Knight's Base.
Talk to Lord Daquarius in the southwest room with the throne, south of the furnace icon.
Kill a Black Knight.
Talk to Lord Daquarius again.
Take twenty unnoted essence to the Mage of Zamorak in the south-east corner of Varrock. [Chat: 2 Solus Dellagar] Make sure not to wear god armour.

sub.t: If you don't already have the essence, have Aubury (in the rune shop north of the Mage of Zamorak) teleport you to the essence mine and mine the 20 essence.
If you are wearing any Saradomin or Guthix gear, you must remove it before speaking to the Mage.

p: A player scanning with the commorb.

steps.t: Talk again to give him the essence. [Chat: 2 Solus Dellagar]
Go to Canifis and you will be contacted, complete the conversation. If you accidentally exit out, right-click 'Contact' on the commorb to restart the dialogue.
Scan using the commorb just outside the Canifis bank to find Solus.
An item will appear in your backpack. The table below shows where to scan next. Repeat this 5 times.

sub.t: If you are wearing one, take off your ring of life; it will not help you and will be destroyed.

p: Solus as a woman, tricking the player.

steps.t: Once you have received the pure essence, teleport to the Rune Essence mine by talking to Carwen Essencebinder in Burthorpe (fastest way from Burthorpe lodestone) or Aubury in Varrock or Archmage Sedridor in the Wizards' Tower. [Chat: 1 yes]
p: Solus's Flames of Zamorak spell nearly killing a player

steps.t: Kill Solus Dellagar.
Give Sir Amik Varze the hat. [Chat: 2 Speak about the Wanted! quest.]
Quest complete!
